name: The archmage
description: The head of the Lat-Nam academy, who in the final scene transforms into a gray-skinned, tentacled woman who is pleased by Jared's involvement.

description_citations.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The archmage reveals himself to be a gray-skinned tentacled woman, pleased that Jared found the book.
timeline.quote: "How lucky you found the book, Jared.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.
